$comment: Allowed ESLint WARNINGS and eslint-disable SUPPRESSIONS per rule – checked by scripts/lint-ratchet.mjs (`pnpm lint`). Numbers only go down: `pnpm lint --tighten` lowers them after a fix; never raise one to make a new warning or disable pass. The exhaustive-deps ones are each a behaviour decision (adding the dependency re-runs the effect), so they are capped, not silenced; «the latest X without re-running» is useEffectEvent, and a disable that stays says why on its line.
